description: This file defines data structures, enums, and type aliases related to cell reselection parameters in 3GPP NR (5G) specifications, including hysteresis, thresholds, priorities, and carrier info.

classes.name: intra_freq_neigh_cell_info
classes.description: Contains information about intra-frequency neighbor cells, including PCI and Qoffset.

classes.name: inter_freq_carrier_freq_info
classes.description: Holds information about inter-frequency carrier parameters for cell reselection, including ARFCN, subcarrier spacing, thresholds, and offsets.

classes.name: carrier_freq_eutra
classes.description: Represents EUTRA carrier frequency info for cell reselection, including ARFCN, bandwidth, priority, thresholds, and power limits.
